The '''63rd [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] for [[2005 in film|2005]], were presented on January 16, 2006, at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]], in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Waxman|first1=Sharon|title=At the Globes, 'Brokeback Mountain' Takes Top Awards|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2006/01/17/arts/at-the-globes-brokeback-mountain-takes-top-awards.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=17 January 2006|archive-date=January 10, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110174703/http://www.nytimes.com/2006/01/17/arts/at-the-globes-brokeback-mountain-takes-top-awards.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Horn|first1=John|last2=King|first2=Susan|title='Brokeback' is high in the saddle|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2006-jan-17-et-goldenmain17-story.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=17 January 2006|archive-date=December 18, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191218080036/http://articles.latimes.com/2006/jan/17/entertainment/et-goldenmain17|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=‘Walk the Line,’ ‘Brokeback’ win Golden Globes|url=https://www.today.com/popculture/walk-line-brokeback-win-golden-globes-wbna10878303|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Today.com|date=16 January 2006|archive-date=January 10, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110174852/https://www.today.com/popculture/walk-line-brokeback-win-golden-globes-wbna10878303|url-status=live}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 13, 2005.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Silverman|first1=Stephen|title=Brokeback, Housewives Top Globe Nods|url=http://people.com/celebrity/brokeback-housewives-top-globe-nods/|website=People|access-date=10 January 2018|date=13 December 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110175316/http://people.com/celebrity/brokeback-housewives-top-globe-nods/|archive-date=10 January 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Vries|first1=Lloyd|title='Brokeback Mountain' Leads Globes|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/brokeback-mountain-leads-globes/|access-date=10 January 2018|work=CBS News|date=13 December 2005|archive-date=January 11, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180111052638/https://www.cbsnews.com/news/brokeback-mountain-leads-globes/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Karger|first1=Dave|title=The Golden Globes start the Oscar race|url=http://ew.com/article/2005/12/16/golden-globes-start-oscar-race/|website=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=10 January 2018|date=16 December 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170318180626/http://ew.com/article/2005/12/16/golden-globes-start-oscar-race/|archive-date=18 March 2017}}</ref>

The ceremony aired on Monday rather than its traditional Sunday after the previous year ceremony's ratings were negatively impacted by the popularity of ''[[Desperate Housewives]]''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Globes moved to avoid Housewives|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/4748401.stm|website=BBC News|date=5 August 2005|access-date=11 January 2016|archive-date=January 7, 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260107055022/http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/4748401.stm|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Trivia==
* "E!" network covered the Golden Globes for six hours prior to the airing of the event.
* At no time during the telecast was a "tribute" made to those in the entertainment industry who have passed on within the past year.
